name: startup-slow-ramp
description: Issue #11: slow supply-ramp startup transient (sibling to sim/startup/'s fast ramp) for bandgap_top with the bandgap_startup circuit in the loop. The slow ramp is the classic trap the Implementation guidance flags: the loop can track a slow ramp into a stalled state that a fast ramp/step never exposes. Ramp rate: 0V->final over 1 ms (comparable to the ratified startup bound itself -- deliberately slower than any realistic supply/LDO power-up rate for this rail, without extending full-PVT sim runtime past what is practical for this record).
claim: README.md#target-specification (Startup row: self-starting at all corners incl. SS/-40C/2.97V, < 1 ms to within 1% of final value, must hold under a slow ramp as well as a fast one)
analyses:
let n = length(time)
let vf = v(vref)[n-1]
let iqf = -i(vsup)[n-1]*1e6
let iq_su = v.xtop.vsu_sense#branch[n-1]*1e6
let detf = v(xtop.xx3.det)[n-1]
let tol = 0.01 * abs(vf)
let lo = vf - tol
let hi = vf + tol
let idx = n-1
let inband = 1
while inband = 1 AND idx > 0
  if v(vref)[idx-1] < lo | v(vref)[idx-1] > hi
    let inband = 0
  else
    let idx = idx - 1
  end
end
let t_settle = time[idx]
let vdd_final = v(vdd)[n-1]
let thresh = 0.9*vdd_final
let j = 0
let above = 0
while above = 0 AND j < n-1
  if v(vdd)[j] >= thresh
    let above = 1
  else
    let j = j + 1
  end
end
let t0 = time[j]
let startup_time = t_settle - t0

startup_time_s.description: same measurement convention as sim/startup/'s fast-ramp record: t=0 at vdd crossing 90% of final, settled = last exit from +/-1% of vref's own final value via a robust backward scan. A negative value (settled before vdd even reached 90% of final) is the expected, best-case outcome for a slow ramp and still a clean PASS against the 1 ms bound.

vref_final_v.description: sanity window, same bound as sim/bandgap-loop-smoke/ (issue #8) -- not the ratified +/-2% spec window; catches a gross convergence/stall failure, not a spec-conformance claim (amp sizing is #10).

det_final_v.description: clean-disengagement sanity bound, same as sim/startup/.
